scope: Read-only audit of locally available public WorldAgen TTT code. Missing LIBERO trainer prevents statements about all original LIBERO TTT internals.

calvin_online_collection.policy_text: task annotation at ttt.py:63-68 and passed to step_agent at :96-103; modifying it changes behavior policy and generated data, violating fixed-action/fixed-policy-goal isolation
calvin_online_collection.adaptation_text: literal no lang tokenized at :69-70, repeated unconditionally at :139, saved as trajectory_data[text] at :150
calvin_online_collection.conclusion: Changing only a legal task goal in the supported online sampler does not change adaptation text; fixed-data Goal-Swap is not an existing exposed adaptation-goal operation.

cached_data_loader.reader: ttt.py:221 np.load(... allow_pickle=True).item(); :227 directly converts stored text to tensor
cached_data_loader.trainer: ttt.py:340/351/361 passes cached input_texts into model as text_token without canonicalizing to no lang
cached_data_loader.skip_online_collection: ttt.py:288 if not args.use_sampled_data; --use_sampled_data therefore permits cache-only training
cached_data_loader.all_data: ttt_use_all_data loads all matching cached files instead of current test subset
cached_data_loader.conclusion: Writing pretokenized cache text can reach the native CALVIN trainer; this requires authority over adaptation-data files and is a distinct data-poisoning threat model. This audit does not establish attacker access to that cache or decision harm.

libero_path.ttt_use_test_text_instruction: Declared at arguments_utils.py:265 and passed by scripts/libero/eval_ttt.sh:73; no consumer in available Python implementation
libero_path.conclusion: Cannot infer original LIBERO adaptation text semantics from the CALVIN sampler or a shell flag whose implementation is missing.

local_reconstruction_classification.CleanTTT_taskGoal: New adaptation metadata interface, not faithful native no-lang baseline
local_reconstruction_classification.SwapTTT_taskGoal: Diagnostic intervention through that new interface, not native online-sampler Goal-Swap
local_reconstruction_classification.EmptyTTT_empty_string: Useful canonicalization baseline but tokenwise different from native literal no lang
local_reconstruction_classification.native_threat_boundary_verdict: No-Go for claiming native online TTT Goal-Swap decision attack based on the current reconstructed taskGoal adaptation interface. Cache-text poisoning is a separate candidate requiring explicit writable-data threat assumption and matched native no-lang controls.
